Data protection

Privacy policy

Controller

LECKERDING GmbH, represented by Shawn Xavier Veldhuis, Warschauer Straße 59A, 10243 Berlin, Germany. Email: info@leckerding.com.

Website access data

When you visit the website, your browser may send access information to the hosting provider. Temporary server logs can contain your IP address, date and time, requested URL, referring website, browser and operating system. These data are used for safe and reliable website operation.

Enquiries

We process contact details and messages you voluntarily send to us for handling enquiries and follow-up communication. The static form on this website does not transmit or store form data on our own server. Instead, it prepares a draft for your chosen email application or WhatsApp, which only sends after your confirmation.

Cookies and local storage

There are no advertising or analytics trackers. We use browser localStorage to remember your privacy choice. If you opt in, we can also remember your language preference locally. You can revisit your choice through the cookie preferences link in the footer. Hosting-provider cookies, if any, must be verified before launch.

WhatsApp

WhatsApp is not embedded or loaded automatically. Our QR code is stored locally. Clicking WhatsApp or scanning the QR code opens an external Meta/WhatsApp service with separate privacy terms. You can contact us by phone or email instead.

Disclosure and lawful bases

We disclose personal data only if permitted by law or with your consent. Processing may rely on Article 6(1)(a), (b), (c) or (f) GDPR, as applicable.

Your rights

You may exercise rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and withdrawal of consent under applicable law. You may also complain to the relevant data protection authority. Please contact us using the address above.

This is an English overview for the redesigned prototype. A final legal review of the actual IONOS hosting setup, retention periods and processors is needed before publication. See the German version.
